CacheLancer.Description: One of the crews working the mist roads between the harbour and the estate, living off whatever the caches were meant to carry.
CacheLancer.Name: Cache Lancer

TantoBoss.Description: A tanto wielder who shreds up close, drills through its prey, and drags it back for the kill.
TantoBoss.Name: Tanto Boss

WaterTrainee.Description: Urokodaki's star pupil, who cleared this same regimen years ago and never let it soften him.
WaterTrainee.Name: Water Trainee Sabito

HighDemon.Description: A demon that lived long enough for its blood to turn. The art it carries has had the practice.
HighDemon.Name: High Demon

WindTrainee.Description: Saneri's student, drilled until every swing cuts straight through hesitation.
WindTrainee.Name: Wind Trainee

StalkerDemon.Description: A demon that stalks lone slayers through the Final Selection. It does not lose interest.
StalkerDemon.Name: Rogue Demon

IceveilRoadPikeman.Description: The one who carries a spear, and has used it on this road before.
IceveilRoadPikeman.Name: Road Pikeman

Fujiko.Description: A duelist who keeps a bladed wagasa open in any weather. Whatever falls from it is not rain.
Fujiko.Name: Fujiko

Mizunoto.Description: A promising Mizunoto-rank Demon Slayer who survived encounters that should have killed them -- marked by the Demon King before they can grow into a real threat.
Mizunoto.Name: Mizunoto

InsectTrainee.Description: Shinora's student, all elegance right up to the moment the poison lands.
InsectTrainee.Name: Insect Trainee

GreaterDemon_ButterflyEstate.Description: One that fed long enough to keep its own shape. It carries two blood arts where a lesser carries one.
GreaterDemon_ButterflyEstate.Name: Greater Demon

Civilian.Description: A peaceful villager going about their day.
Civilian.Name: Civilian

SoundDuelist.Description: He kept the Sound Cleavers when their maker died, and has been waiting for someone worth losing them to.
SoundDuelist.Name: Duelist Hibiki

HandDemon.Description: A hulking demon whose body sprouts countless grasping arms. It has ended every Final Selection it has seen.
HandDemon.Name: Hand Demon

SmallYeti.Description: A young yeti, one of the Yeti Demon's underlings, small but aggressive.
SmallYeti.Name: Small Yeti

SerpentTrainee.Description: Obari's student, patient enough to wait out anyone who swings first.
SerpentTrainee.Name: Serpent Trainee

LancerCaptain.Description: The one who found the cache first, and means to keep it.
LancerCaptain.Name: Lancer Captain

DemonPhysicalAttacks.Description: A dev demon for building out the physical-attack skill kit.
DemonPhysicalAttacks.Name: Demon Physical Attacks

Sumari.Description: The Temari Demon. She plays exactly one game, and the ball is faster than you.
Sumari.Name: Sumari

FlameCaster.Description: A caster that hurls balls of raw flame.
FlameCaster.Name: Flame Caster

Lost.Description: A slayer who never came down from a Final Selection long past. Whatever he is now guards the drowned chamber.
Lost.Name: Lost

RogueDemon.Description: A demon that stalks lone slayers through the Final Selection. It does not lose interest.
RogueDemon.Name: Rogue Demon

ScytheBoss.Description: A scythe-wielding boss for building out the Scythe skill kit.
ScytheBoss.Name: Scythe Boss

LesserDemon_ButterflyEstate.Description: A demon that never grew into anything. It holds the cavern floor for the greater ones above, and throws itself at whatever comes in.
LesserDemon_ButterflyEstate.Name: Lesser Demon

ZoneDemon.Description: A demon drawn to the slayer holding the zone. It knows nothing but its hunger.
ZoneDemon.Name: Rogue Demon

Rengu.Description: The Flame Hashira. His blade burns hot enough that the air ahead of it gives way first.
Rengu.Name: Rengu

Mizunoto_MistfallHarbor.Description: A promising Mizunoto-rank Demon Slayer who survived encounters that should have killed them -- marked by the Demon King before they can grow into a real threat.
Mizunoto_MistfallHarbor.Name: Mizunoto

VillageSpy.Description: A spy hiding among Windy Peak's villagers, passing coded orders to bandits outside the village.
VillageSpy.Name: Villager (Spy)

YetiDemon.Description: A towering yeti demon whose frozen fists crush anything that wanders too close.
YetiDemon.Name: Yeti Demon

Gyutai.Description: The Blood Sickle Demon. His blood leaves his body sharpened, and he never runs out.
Gyutai.Name: Gyutai

KaidenSub.Description: A bandit sworn to Kaiden, prowling the bamboo paths.
KaidenSub.Name: Kaiden Subordinate

LesserDemon.Description: A demon prowling the Final Selection mountain, free of the wisteria's reach.
LesserDemon.Name: Lesser Demon

TaiChiTrainee.Description: Renjiro's senior student, who has never once been where a strike expected her to be.
TaiChiTrainee.Name: Tai Chi Trainee Suzume

Reaper.Description: The Sonic Reaper Demon. The scythe arrives on the echo; by the time you hear it, the cut has already happened.
Reaper.Name: Reaper

MizunoeDemonSlayer.Description: Second rank, and the first handed a patrol of their own. One breathing form, drilled until it arrives before the thought does.
MizunoeDemonSlayer.Name: Mizunoe Demon Slayer

ReaperTrainee.Description: Zurinyz's senior student, who reaps without ever seeming to hurry.
ReaperTrainee.Name: Reaper Trainee Kuzan

Domae.Description: The Cryokinetic Demon. He smiles like a host, and the room freezes around the welcome.
Domae.Name: Domae

IceveilRoadMarauder.Description: Tanto in hand, and never alone. The last thing between a load of firewood and the village.
IceveilRoadMarauder.Name: Road Marauder

RaidCaptain.Description: The one who found the cache first, and means to keep it.
RaidCaptain.Name: Raid Captain

BeastBornDemon_MistfallHarbor.Description: A demon that came back wrong from something animal. They raid settlements after dark and go for whoever runs slowest.
BeastBornDemon_MistfallHarbor.Name: Beast Born Demon

Obari.Description: The Serpent King. He waits through everything you have, then takes the one opening you left.
Obari.Name: Obari

Datai.Description: The Obi Demon. Her sash reaches further than any blade, and it does not let go.
Datai.Name: Datai

ProwlerCaptain.Description: The one who found the cache first, and means to keep it.
ProwlerCaptain.Name: Prowler Captain

WarFansBoss.Description: A fan dancer whose every step calls the winter wind.
WarFansBoss.Name: War Fans Boss

Enru.Description: The Dream Demon. The lullaby is a courtesy; the flesh underneath is not.
Enru.Name: Enru

ReapingBladesBoss.Description: A reaping blades stylist who reels its prey in with a spinning dash and cleaves it away.
ReapingBladesBoss.Name: Reaping Blades Boss

BearCub.Description: A young bear cub, one of the Mother Bear's underlings -- small but aggressive.
BearCub.Name: Bear Cub

Horse.Description: A docile horse wandering the fields.
Horse.Name: Horse

Saneri.Description: The Wind Hashira. He does not cut around what is in the way; he cuts through it and keeps going.
Saneri.Name: Saneri

Yahari.Description: The Arrow Demon. His arrows do not miss; they simply have not turned yet.
Yahari.Name: Yahari

Zentaro.Description: The Thunder King. Blink and the bout is already over; the thunder arrives late.
Zentaro.Name: Zentaro

Akazo.Description: The Shockwave Demon. Every technique he ever studied, compressed into fists that break the air first.
Akazo.Name: Akazo

IceProfoundDemon.Description: The frost it walks in is not the season's. Whatever it was before, the cold finished the argument.
IceProfoundDemon.Name: Ice Profound Demon

KaruVillageBandit.Description: A common bandit found lurking near Windy Peak.
KaruVillageBandit.Name: Windy Peak Bandit

Giyen.Description: The Water Hashira. He does not meet a blade so much as let it pass, and answer where it left him room.
Giyen.Name: Giyen

FlameTrainee.Description: Rengu's top student, and the last wall between a hopeful and Flame Breathing.
FlameTrainee.Name: Flame Trainee

TaiChiBoss.Description: A Tai Chi master who closes the gap in a blink and vanishes into a flurry.
TaiChiBoss.Name: Tai Chi Boss

Kaiden.Description: A savage duelist who tears through foes with clawed gauntlets.
Kaiden.Name: Kaiden

SoryuTrainee.Description: Kazuma's senior student, who has broken more arms teaching this lesson than he can count.
SoryuTrainee.Name: Soryu Trainee Goki

FrostCaster.Description: A caster that hurls bolts of raw frost.
FrostCaster.Name: Frost Caster

Dummy.Description: A target dummy. It takes hits, wears marks, and punches back.
Dummy.Name: Dummy

CacheProwler.Description: One of the knife crews working the snowfields above the settlement, close enough behind a traveller to be on them before the cold is noticed.
CacheProwler.Name: Cache Prowler

Hoyuzo.Description: A relentless reaper who fights with twin sickles.
Hoyuzo.Name: Hoyuzo

Tengai.Description: The Sound Hashira. He calls a fight a festival, and he has never once been quiet about winning one.
Tengai.Name: Tengai

SoundTrainee.Description: Tengai's student, loud enough to be heard over a fight they have already won.
SoundTrainee.Name: Sound Trainee

GauntletBoss.Description: A dev boss for building out the Gauntlet skill kit.
GauntletBoss.Name: Gauntlet Boss

Zuko.Description: A fierce mini boss who guards the outskirts of Windy Peak.
Zuko.Name: Zuko

Shinora.Description: The Insect Hashira. Too slight to behead a demon, so she made every strike carry poison instead.
Shinora.Name: Shinora

SpearBoss.Description: A spear-wielding boss for building out the Spear skill kit.
SpearBoss.Name: Spear Boss

TestBandit.Description: A bandit that turns up carrying one slayer skill, never the same one twice.
TestBandit.Name: Test Bandit

SoryuBoss.Description: A Soryu grappler who baits the strike, snaps the arm, and drives faces into the dirt.
SoryuBoss.Name: Soryu Boss

BloodHoundedDemon_MistfallHarbor.Description: A demon that hunts by the smell of blood alone. They den in packs, and a pack that has tasted a village never leaves it.
BloodHoundedDemon_MistfallHarbor.Name: Blood Hounded Demon

ThunderTrainee.Description: Zentaro's student, quick enough to end a bout in one clean strike.
ThunderTrainee.Name: Thunder Trainee

Nezura.Description: The Pyrokinetic Demon. His blood burns whatever it touches, and he bleeds on purpose.
Nezura.Name: Nezura

KanoeDemonSlayer.Description: Fourth rank, and the first that comes looking. Two forms of one breathing, drilled past the point of thinking about them.
KanoeDemonSlayer.Name: Kanoe Demon Slayer

IceveilRoadBandit.Description: A bandit working the mountain road, close enough to know when the settlement sends a man down.
IceveilRoadBandit.Name: Road Bandit

GroveRaider.Description: One of the raiders working the bamboo paths, robbing whoever walks them alone.
GroveRaider.Name: Grove Raider

Gyorei.Description: The Stone Hashira. The largest man in the Corps, and the one who weeps hardest for the people he buries.
Gyorei.Name: Gyorei

HoyuzoSub.Description: One of Hoyuzo's goons, standing guard around his cave.
HoyuzoSub.Name: Hoyuzo Subordinate

MotherBear.Description: A ferocious mother bear, fiercely protective of her territory.
MotherBear.Name: Mother Bear

FireProfoundDemon.Description: It burns without fuel and without pause. The snow around it has not been snow for a long while.
FireProfoundDemon.Name: Fire Profound Demon

StoneTrainee.Description: Gyorei's student, who learned to stand still until standing still became the attack.
StoneTrainee.Name: Stone Trainee
